_comment: Example/reference bake-off profile for wheel detection on car crops. Opt-in: nothing loads it unless you select it by path (--profile examples/bakeoff/vehicle_wheel/profile.json). There is no ground truth for wheels in COCO: you label wheels through the pipeline plus human review, export, and bake off against that. triton_model is intentionally empty -- set it (or pass --triton-model) to the wheel detector your Triton server serves after you promote one. The COCO vehicle class (id 2 = car) in context_class_ids scores wheels only inside detected cars.
name: vehicle_wheel
description: Single wheel class; car->wheel crop mode via the COCO car class
